difficultyRationale: Tests the default charset specified by the convenience overload of Files.readString.
prompt: Which charset does `Files.readString(path)` use when no charset argument is supplied?
explanation: The one-argument `Files.readString(Path)` method decodes the file using UTF-8.

options.explanation: This convenience overload specifies UTF-8 rather than delegating to the platform default.
UTF-8 is the documented charset for the one-argument overload.
UTF-16 is not the default for this method.
The method is specified to use UTF-8.
